info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Weather Alerts Regions-v3-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Regions API provides users with real-time information about weather alert regions. This endpoint enables developers to access a list of different regions where weather alerts are currently active, facilitating timely responses to severe weather conditions. Ideal for applications focused on meteorological services, emergency management, and public safety, this API supports both individual users and organizations aiming to stay informed about regional weather threats. By leveraging this endpoint, applications can proactively communicate alerts and ensure preparedness among users.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch alerts that are specific to a particular geographic region, helping in monitoring and decision-making based on regional events.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify parameters for retrieving alerts based on the specified region. Ensure that the correct JSON structure is followed for successful processing.

200.description: The request was successful and alerts data for the specified region is returned.
